Historical full-card image of [[ComScan Detection (V) (Virtual Set 13: Remote Outpost) (Original)|ComScan Detection]], matching the [[Virtual Set 13: Remote Outpost]] publisher slip. It combines the underlying Decipher card and the Virtual slip. The same image was recovered unchanged from the Holotable large-image distribution through Virtual Set 17.
